§6Motors§f

§aThe guts of every machine. You'll burn through stacks of these.§f

§6Standard Motor§f: Crafted at a table, anvil, or arc welder. Uses red copper wire, iron plates, copper coils, and ring coils.

§6Desh Motor§f: For advanced machines and power armor. Made at a table or Tier 3 anvil from polymer, dense gold wire, desh, and a standard motor.

§6Bismuth Motor§f: The top tier. Uses bismuth, dense superconducting coils, cast steel plate, and HSS ingots.

Standard motors get consumed by the dozen, so batch-craft a bunch whenever you can. The recipes vary by crafting method (table vs anvil vs arc welder), so check JEI for the one that works best for your setup.

§ePS:§f Desh and bismuth motors show up later for power armor and endgame machines. Don't worry about them yet.
